name: Automated Review & Polish

tasks.content: Delete residual onClick, hover Tailwind classes flagged in .cursor/plan.json and verify no interactive props remain.
Run `npm run build` and ensure total JS bundle < 500 KB; adjust manualChunks in vite.config.ts if needed.
Replace remaining TypeScript `any` placeholders and add JSDoc for public APIs. References: research/tavus_cvi_research.md, research/openai_structured_outputs_api_research.md
Run `npm run report:a11y` + Lighthouse. Fix violations, target Lighthouse score ≥ 95.
Move obsolete files (legacy Weather components, etc.) into /archive/2025-07-29/ and ensure no imports remain.
Run Prettier and ESLint repo-wide. Fix lint errors.

Add integration tests for Edge Function (streamText + tool call) and FastAPI endpoints using Pytest and React Testing Library. References: research/vercel_ai_sdk_v5_research.md, research/weaviate_v4_client_research.md

learned_insights: Environment separation: root .env for backend, frontend .env for React + Edge Functions.
Vercel Dev is required for AI SDK v5 Edge Functions locally (port 3000).
Data API must run concurrently on port 8000 for tool calls.
AI SDK v5 breaking changes handled: useChat status, sendMessage, UIMessage parts parsing.
